commands.name: capabilities
commands.summary: This document: Kim's commands and what each one may change

commands.name: catalog.list
commands.summary: Tools in the signed catalog and their status on this machine

commands.name: catalog.show
commands.summary: One tool with its releases and the package for this machine

commands.name: catalog.status
commands.summary: Catalog in use (bundled or cached), signer, freshness and cache location

commands.name: catalog.verify
commands.summary: Verify any catalog file and its signature

commands.name: catalog.refresh
commands.summary: Fetch and verify the catalog, then update the local cache

commands.name: install
commands.summary: Download, verify and activate a tool (explicit; never implicit)

commands.name: update.check
commands.summary: List available updates; never downloads a package (--refresh updates the catalog cache first)

commands.name: update
commands.summary: Install the newest compatible release of an installed tool (explicit)

commands.name: uninstall
commands.summary: Remove a tool's program files; user data is kept unless --purge-data

commands.name: tools.list
commands.summary: Installed Kim tools with version, executable and capabilities (reads files only)

commands.name: tools.describe
commands.summary: One installed tool and its capabilities; optionally checks requirements

commands.name: tools.find
commands.summary: The installed tools that provide a capability (id, interface version, executable, availability); reads manifests only unless --probe

commands.name: tools.invoke
commands.summary: Invoke a capability of another installed tool headlessly, with the consent its effect needs (read freely; write with --allow-write; destructive also --yes; install never)

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Kim version, catalog freshness, settings, installed tools and available updates

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Kim's version and the CLI contract and schema versions it speaks

commands.name: settings.show
commands.summary: Settings and the file they are stored in

commands.name: settings.set
commands.summary: Change one setting

commands.name: hotkeys.list
commands.summary: Kim Manager's shortcuts: every action with its keys, scope, source and state

commands.name: hotkeys.show
commands.summary: One shortcut action with its bindings and every conflict that involves it

commands.name: hotkeys.set
commands.summary: Replace an action's bindings; a conflicting change is refused (hotkey_conflict) and nothing is written

commands.name: hotkeys.disable
commands.summary: Disable one shortcut, all of them or one scope

commands.name: hotkeys.enable
commands.summary: Turn all shortcuts or one scope back on

commands.name: hotkeys.reset
commands.summary: Restore an action's default, or discard every change (--all keeps a backup)

commands.name: hotkeys.check
commands.summary: Conflict report for Kim's shortcuts; --all-tools reads every installed tool's hotkey files (starts nothing)

commands.name: hotkeys.export
commands.summary: Print Kim's hotkeys.json user layer

commands.name: hotkeys.import
commands.summary: Validate a kim.hotkeys document and replace the user layer (keeps a backup)

summary: Explicit, user-controlled catalog and installer for Kim tools
